turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes, and the first thing I want to know is why my son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, before anyone called me. Who decided it, and on what basis?
You're welcome. Now answer my question: who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Crazy weather today, eh? Did you see the Flames game?

We're not here about the weather, Hale. The zero went in on November 3rd and nobody called me, so either you tell me who decided it and on what basis, or I walk down to the principal's office right now.
What do you do for fun?
I'm not here to make friends, Hale. You asked for this meeting, so you've got one more chance to tell me about Owen's essay before I go upstairs and ask the principal instead.
